ignoreCommand: s=$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA; [ -z "$s" ] && exit 1; git cat-file -e "$s^{commit}" 2>/dev/null || exit 1; git diff --quiet "$s" HEAD -- src/ index.html public/ package.json package-lock.json .npmrc vite.config.js vercel.json

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://accounts.google.com; connect-src 'self' https://www.googleapis.com https://accounts.google.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'
